text: Nina's got the second interview at the council on Thursday. Remind me to text her good luck the night before, she was properly shaking about the first one
fatima start date confirmed, 3rd nov, junior analyst at the bank. buzzing

Layla's mum is in for her hip op sometime next week. Layla's going up to stay with her for a few days and her brother Yaw is covering the weekend shifts at the restaurant so she can. Their dad's not much use apparently. Layla sounded tired. Check in with Layla that evening once she knows how it went, and maybe send her mum some flowers the week after
Kai said Jada applied for the head of year role, hears back end of the month. she hasn't said anything to the others
So Rosa was telling me Luca and Dalia are finally doing the housewarming, Saturday the 14th I think, and they want everyone to bring a dish. Rosa's doing dessert. I said I'd bring the lamb thing.
ravi - vegan now, also allergic to sesame. note for dinner
Don't forget to ring Björn the day after his panel interview, it's Tuesday. He's been prepping for weeks.
Zofia's dog Pickle had surgery on his leg this morning. Zofia sounded wrecked. Pop round with something tomorrow
miriam and her husband off to Lisbon over half term. anniversary trip, 10 years
Mia nervous about her driving test next Wednesday, failed the last one on a roundabout lol. wish her luck tues night

Matilda Sato (Tilly) is leaving the agency end of the month, leaving drinks probably the Friday after. Need to sort a card and get people to chip in, she's mentioned wanting one of those fancy coffee grinders
Ifeoma's PhD viva got moved to early March. She's relieved honestly, needed the extra time
Arturo's flat viewing fell through, landlord pulled it. He's back on Rightmove every night
Leon got the job!! the one at the design studio. starts in a fortnight

Luis told me his dad has been in and out of hospital since the summer, heart stuff, and his mum isn't coping brilliantly on her own. He's trying to get compassionate leave to go back to Valencia, probably early November for a couple of weeks, but his boss is being difficult about it. Should call him this weekend

Mabel's 70th is Sunday 2nd. Her daughter Jasmine is doing a surprise lunch at the Crown, about twenty people, and her son Michael is flying back from Dubai for it. Jasmine said Mabel's been getting really into her allotment, so garden centre vouchers would go down well. Remind me to RSVP by Friday
pick up dry cleaning thurs, dentist 9am fri
Arjun has his final round with the consultancy on Monday morning, then he's flying to Delhi on Wednesday for his cousin's wedding. Text him Monday afternoon to see how it went before he goes off grid
Joy and Lena got engaged at the weekend! Lena's sister apparently knew for months. Send congrats to them both
Mustafa works nights at the depot now. Easier to catch him late mornings
Angela's son Michael is starting reception in September, she's already panicking about uniforms
Ioana - turns out she plays cello in a community orchestra, concert sometime in December. Would love to go
Emre was supposed to have his leaving do Friday but it's been called off, the redundancies got postponed. He's in limbo, not great
Gintaras moving to Glasgow early next year for his partner's job. He's sad to leave the five-a-side lot
Note to self: finish my own application for the Edinburgh role by Sunday. Cover letter still needs work. I'm asking Nina to read it over Saturday.
Fatima's brother Kai just passed his bar exams, family party next weekend. She asked if I'd come. Get him a card
Layla said Yaw has been really low since the breakup. They split in August. She's worried about him and so am I honestly. Message Yaw sometime this week, nothing heavy, just see if he fancies a pint
Rosa Lopez (we were at uni together) is a midwife at St Mary's now. Lives in Leyton with her girlfriend
jada interview tmrw 2pm, really stressed, said she barely slept. text her in the morning

Called Luca back. His daughter's school play is the week after next, she's a sheep apparently. He and Dalia are both going, then dinner at her parents' after. He mentioned Dalia's birthday is that weekend too, she's been dropping hints about a new pair of running shoes

Dalia's grandmother passed away on Monday. Funeral likely end of next week. Dalia flying to Beirut Thursday with her mum and sister Zofia, back sometime the week after. She asked if I could feed their cat Biscuit while they're away, said of course. Don't forget to get the spare key off her Wednesday
Remind me to send Ravi the job link for the Moreau & Co analyst post before Friday, closing date is Monday
Björn's cat Smilla went missing last night, he's put posters up everywhere. Ask him tomorrow if she's turned up
Zofia mentioned her partner Miriam is doing her first marathon in April, training like mad. Zofia's doing the cheering
Met Mia's new boyfriend, Arturo. Nice guy, works in IT, big into climbing
matilda's mum diagnosed with diabetes last month, tilly's doing all the hospital runs. she's knackered

Ifeoma got offered the lectureship in Leeds!! Interview was only last Thursday and she was convinced she'd blown the presentation. Starts January, so she and her partner Arjun will be house hunting up there over Christmas. She's thrilled but a bit sad about leaving London. Need to take her out to celebrate sometime next week
Leon and his wife Joy expecting their second, due over the summer. Their eldest Mabel is very excited apparently
Luis has his citizenship test on the 28th. Asked if I could quiz him on the Sunday before, said yes
Angela recommended that Thai place on Mill Road, said get the green curry
Jasmine applying for a masters in architecture, deadline mid January. She asked me for a reference, need to write it by end of November. Should ask her for her CV first
Arjun's wife Lena had their baby Tuesday night!! Little girl. Everyone fine. Must get a present before we visit next weekend
Mustafa's daughter Layla got into Manchester for medicine. He was beaming

So I had a long chat with Ioana tonight. Her job at the publishers is going really badly, new manager keeps moving goalposts, she's applying elsewhere and has an interview with Penguin sometime next week, Wednesday or Thursday. She's nervous, hasn't interviewed in six years. Her husband Emre thinks she should just quit. I said I'd help her prep, maybe Sunday afternoon. Remind me to message her the morning of the interview and then call that evening to hear how it went.
Emre hates coriander, don't let him near the curry
Gintaras and his wife are taking the kids to Lapland for Christmas, first time abroad for the little one
gym Mon Wed Fri this week. Car MOT due end of month, book it
Nina said her dad retires on Friday after 40 years at the post office. Big do at the social club Saturday. Nina's a bit emotional about it
Arturo's sister Rosa is staying with him for a few weeks while she looks for work. He's sleeping on the sofa lol

voice memo. Kai's mock exams are early December and his mum Dalia says he's not revising at all, gaming every night till one. She's at the end of her tether. His dad Mustafa is meant to be having a word with him this weekend. I offered to do a bit of maths tutoring with Kai on Tuesdays, need to dig out my old notes

Before I forget: Michael's 40th surprise party, Saturday 22nd at theirs. His partner Mia is organising, says keep it quiet. Bring a bottle and a card, he collects vinyl so maybe a record. Also need to tell Luca and Ravi, they don't know yet. Should ring Mia on the Thursday to check numbers.
Zofia had her redundancy meeting this morning. Package is decent but she's gutted. Taking a few weeks before she starts applying. Check in on her at the weekend
ravi's interview at the hospital went well he thinks, hears back fri. ask him monday
Fatima Kaur from the book club - her son Arjun just started at Bristol, she's missing him loads
Yaw's band has a gig at the Lexington next Saturday, him on bass. Said I'd go, getting tickets tonight

Long call with Mum. Auntie Miriam's knee op went fine on Tuesday, she's home already but her cousin Rosa is staying to help for a fortnight. Mum wants us all to visit over Christmas, probably the 27th. Nothing much else, the dog's fine.
Jada's wedding is off. She and Leon split up last month, she only told me today. She seems ok but who knows. Should take her for coffee soon
Mabel's grandson Luca is doing his Duke of Edinburgh expedition this weekend, she's fretting about the weather
Joy (JoJo) has a job interview Friday at the theatre, front of house manager. Wish her luck Thursday night and ask how it went on the weekend
Angela thinks her husband Gintaras might be up for promotion in the new year. Fingers crossed for him
